verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a versioned REST API, a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec with a generated Postman collection, an MCP server, and a CLI, but none of it shows official client SDK libraries. The OpenAPI spec and Postman collection are building blocks a developer could use to generate or hand-write a client, not official SDKs. Community API wrapper scripts are a user-side workaround and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
